summary.title: Best Automotive and EV Education Options in EU / Schengen After Grade 12
summary.subtitle: 2027 intake planning for a Pakistani CBSE student living in Kuwait
summary.evidenceRule: Evidence-based parent decision report | Research date: 11 September 2026
summary.mainConclusion: For this student, Europe is not one market. The best choice depends on whether the priority is practical automotive engineering, EV/electronics, autonomous systems, low cost, or access to a strong automotive industry cluster. The research found that the Netherlands and Finland provide the cleanest combination of English-taught applied engineering and practical learning. Germany provides exceptional automotive industry proximity but surprisingly few fully English undergraduate automotive programmes. Hungary and Lithuania offer lower-cost English-taught vehicle engineering routes, while Italy offers a prestigious automotive pathway with an English curriculum option.
bullets: 1: Fontys UAS, Netherlands - Automotive Engineering BSc — Best practical/EV balance. English, labs, company projects, internships, Brainport Eindhoven and an unusually hands-on Electric Drive minor.
2: HAN UAS, Netherlands - Automotive Engineering BSc — Best mature all-round English automotive bachelor. Strong vehicle systems, control, design, internships and industry-facing projects.
3: Metropolia UAS, Finland - Automotive Electrics BEng — Best targeted EV/electronics route. English, labs, projects, 30 ECTS work placement, automotive electrics and electronics.

4: Széchenyi István University, Hungary - Vehicle Engineering BSc — Excellent value, English, Audi Hungaria faculty, vehicle manufacturing, maintenance, diagnostics and mandatory industrial internship.
5: TH Ingolstadt, Germany - Autonomous Vehicle Engineering BEng — Best English bachelor for ADAS/autonomous/connected vehicles, with vehicle electronics, V2X, sensor fusion and a 24 ECTS internship.
summary.availability: For 2027, several institutions have already published 2027 dates or fee changes. Others still show 2026/27 information. Every such case is marked “2027 not yet published; latest official intake used.” No programme is treated as English-taught unless an official source explicitly states English as the teaching language.
